name: @sos-2/deployment
description: SOS 2.0 Deployment: the deployment contract — typed deployment records (exact artifact revision, target runtime ref, configuration, declared rollback mechanism + trigger + authority MIRRORING the merged @sos-2/recovery-control declarations, which are CONSUMED not duplicated) with a validated lifecycle PLANNED -> DEPLOYED -> ROLLED_BACK; failures preserve truth states (outcome records carry the frozen 6 states and a documented severity-lattice aggregation — a deployment whose status is UNKNOWN is never reported as SUCCESS or FAILURE); and a deterministic deployment simulator (fixed seed, marked simulated, never intervention evidence — the W9 simulator discipline) (Work Order W12; spec/architecture.md sections 17-18, R18, R21).
